ProgramUnit.Name: INITIALISE_WINDOWS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS
BEGIN
 :system.message_level := '10';

 /*set_window_property('window_show',
 title,
 '[ ' || ' DSWAVSIT' || ' 1.01.04 ]'||
 ' Donation Sites Available for a given Time' ); --|| :parameter.p_drive_id); */

 -- [Ver: 01 ] -- :parameter.p_drive_id);
 -- [Ver: 02 ] -- time zone change 
 -- [Ver: 03 ] -- time zone change 
 -- [Ver: 04 ] -- IM 5575
 -- [Ver: 05 ] -- SCR 18384
 -- [Ver: 06 ] -- IM 8497
 -- [Ver: 07 ] -- Removed Duplicate Objects
 
 -- Below Version Got Re-Updated from LT2018
 
 set_window_property('window_show', title, ' DSWAVSIT' || ' [Ver: 01 ]'||
 ' Donation Sites Available for a given Time' ); 
 
 go_block('ctrl_blk_1');
 IF :Parameter.DON_TYPE IS NOT NULL THEN 
 :CTRL_BLK_1.S_DON := :Parameter.DON_TYPE;
 END IF;
 IF :PARAMETER.PROC_CODE is not null THEN
 :CTRL_BLK_1.PROCEDURE_CODE := :Parameter.PROC_CODE;
 END IF;
 IF :PARAMETER.SLOT_DATE is not null THEN
 :CTRL_BLK_1.S_DATE := to_date(:Parameter.SLOT_DATE,'MMDDRR');
 END IF;
 IF :PARAMETER.SLOT_TIME is not null THEN
 :CTRL_BLK_1.START_TIME := to_date(:Parameter.SLOT_TIME,'HH24:MI');
 :CTRL_BLK_1.END_TIME := to_date(:Parameter.SLOT_TIME,'HH24:MI');

 END IF; 
 -----------------------------------------
 IF :PARAMETER.SLOT_DATE is not null THEN
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.s_date');
 validate(item_scope);
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 IF :PARAMETER.DON_TYPE is not null THEN
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.S_DON');
 validate(item_scope);
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 IF :PARAMETER.PROC_CODE is not null THEN
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.procedure_code');
 validate(item_scope);
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 IF :PARAMETER.SLOT_TIME is not null THEN
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.start_time');
 validate(item_scope);
 check_package_failure;
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.end_time');
 validate(item_scope);
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 ----------------------------
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.s_date is not null 
 and :ctrl_blk_1.start_time is not null
 and :ctrl_blk_1.s_don is not null
 and :ctrl_blk_1.procedure_code is not null 
 THEN
 go_block('fixed_sites');
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: FETCH_SITES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE FETCH_SITES IS
 cursor c1(p_start_time in date,p_end_time in date) is
 SELECT distinct fs.site_id, fs.location_name, 
 fss.proc_code, fss.donation_type_group, 
 fss.time_of_day
 FROM fixed_sites fs, fixed_site_slots fss
 WHERE fs.site_id = fss.site_id
 AND fs.chapter_id = fss.chapter_id
 AND fss.max_slots - nvl(fss.booked_slots,0) > 0
 AND fss.sch_date = :ctrl_blk_1.s_date
 AND fss.time_of_day between p_start_time AND p_end_time
 AND fss.donation_type_group in
 (select donation_type_group
 from valid_donation_types
 where donation_type = nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_don,donation_type))
 AND fss.proc_code = nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.procedure_code,fss.proc_code)
 AND fs.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 
 s_time_char varchar2(5) ;
 avl_slots number ;
 v_max_slots number ;
 v_booked_slots number ;
 max_sch_time date ;
 min_sch_time date ;
 temp_date date ;
 slots_found number := 0 ;
 al_button number ;
 v_local_time date;
 v_gmt_time date;
 v_start_date date;
 v_end_date date;
 v_start_time date;
 v_end_time date;
 
begin
 IF :Ctrl_blk_1.s_date is null then
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.s_date');
 show_error('0080');
 END IF; 

 /* IF :Ctrl_blk_1.s_don is null then
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.s_don');
 show_error('0080');
 END IF; 
 IF :Ctrl_blk_1.procedure_code is null then
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.procedure_code');
 show_error('0080');
 END IF; 
 */
 IF :Ctrl_blk_1.start_time is null then
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.start_time');
 show_error('0080');
 END IF; 
 IF :Ctrl_blk_1.end_time is null then
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.end_time');
 show_error('0080');
 END IF; 
 go_block('fixed_sites');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 v_start_time := TO_DATE(to_char(:CTRL_BLK_1.S_DATE,'MM/DD/YYYY') ||' '|| to_char(:CTRL_BLK_1.START_TIME,'HH24MI'),'MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI');
 
 v_end_time := TO_DATE(to_char(:CTRL_BLK_1.S_DATE,'MM/DD/YYYY') ||' '||to_char(:CTRL_BLK_1.END_TIME,'HH24MI'),'MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI');
 
 /* -- Commented by Kishore on 08/20/2011. SCR 18384
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,v_start_time,v_gmt_time);
 v_start_date := v_gmt_time;
 else
 v_start_date := v_start_time;
 end if;
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,v_end_time,v_gmt_time);
 v_end_date := v_gmt_time;
 else
 v_end_date := v_end_time;
 end if;
 -- End of commented section */
 
 v_start_date := v_start_time; -- Added by Kishore on 08/20/2011. SCR 18384
 v_end_date := v_end_time; -- Added by Kishore on 08/20/2011. SCR 18384

 for cur in c1(v_start_date,v_end_date)
 loop
 :fixed_sites.site_id := cur.site_id;
 :fixed_sites.location_name := cur.location_name;
 :fixed_sites.proc_code := cur.proc_code;
 :fixed_sites.donation_type_group := cur.donation_type_group;
 :fixed_sites.time_of_day := cur.time_of_day ;
 
 /* -- Commented by Kishore on 08/20/2011. SCR 18384
 if Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:fixed_sites.time_of_day,v_local_time);
 :fixed_sites.s_time_of_day := to_char(v_local_time,'HH24:MI');
 end if;
 -- End of commented section */ 
 
 next_record;
 end loop;
 IF :system.cursor_record = '1' THEN
 go_block('ctrl_blk_1');
 show_error('11091');
 END IF;
 first_record;
exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
end;
